import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    length = len(line)
    while i < length:
        j = i
        current = line[i]
        while j < length and line[j] == current:
            j += 1
        if (j - i) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
